payloads.title: Medicine (MFDS 202400416)
payloads.summary: This medicine is used for bacterial vaginal infection, stomatitis, and gingivitis.
payloads.content:
Over-the-counter medicine · MedicineThis medicine is used for bacterial vaginal infection, stomatitis, and gingivitis.

Medicine (MFDS 202400416)Based on the official MFDS approval for product code 202400416. Check the ingredient and strength rather than the product name.

This medicine is used for bacterial vaginal infection, stomatitis, and gingivitis.

At a glance

Category

Over-the-counter medicine · Medicine

How it works

This medicine is used for bacterial vaginal infection, stomatitis, and gingivitis.

Why this one

Based on the official MFDS approval for product code 202400416. Check the ingredient and strength rather than the product name.

Who should ask first

If any item in the safety information applies to you, ask the pharmacist at the store first.

How to use it

For patients with a bacterial vaginal infection, place gauze soaked in the solution into the vagina and press the affected area with light pressure for 1 to 3 minutes. Use it twice at intervals of 3 to 4 days. For patients with stomatitis and gingivitis, apply it repeatedly several times using a soaked cotton swab or similar.

Precautions for use

  • Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use it.
  • Do not use it during menstruation.
  • Do not have intercourse or wash with irritating soap.
  • If you forget to use this medicine, do not make up the dose.
  • Simply apply the next dose.
  • Before using this medicine, pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
  • If the symptoms do not go away, consult a doctor.
  • Use it locally only, and be careful that it does not get into the eyes.
  • If it gets into the eyes, rinse them immediately with clean water and then consult a doctor or pharmacist.
  • After using it on the oral mucosa or the gums, rinse the mouth thoroughly.
  • Be careful, as it may weaken latex or rubber products such as condoms and vaginal contraceptive diaphragms.

Possible side effects

  • If local irritation, an allergic reaction, or damage to the enamel of the teeth occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Interactions

  • While using this medicine, do not use it together with other preparations for external use.

This leaflet supports in-store consultation. Ask a pharmacist at the store about product choice and use. Products with the same ingredient, strength and form are managed to the same quality standard. Check by ingredient and strength rather than by product name.

This medicine is used for bacterial vaginal infection, stomatitis, and gingivitis (inflammation of the gums).

At a glance

Category

Over-the-counter medicine · Medicine

How it works

This medicine is used for bacterial vaginal infection, stomatitis, and gingivitis (inflammation of the gums).

Why this one

Based on the official MFDS approval for product code 201702575. Check the ingredient and strength rather than the product name.

Who should ask first

If any item in the safety information applies to you, ask the pharmacist at the store first.

How to use it

For a bacterial vaginal infection, place gauze soaked in the solution into the vagina and press the affected area with light pressure for 1 to 3 minutes. Use it twice at intervals of 3 to 4 days. For stomatitis and gingivitis, apply this medicine repeatedly several times using a cotton swab or similar soaked with it.

Precautions for use

  • Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine.
  • Before using this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
  • This medicine may weaken latex or rubber products such as condoms and vaginal contraceptive diaphragms, so use it with care.
  • Do not use it during menstruation.
  • Do not have intercourse or wash with irritating soap during the treatment period.
  • If you forget to use this medicine, do not make up the dose; simply apply the next dose.
  • Use it locally only.
  • Be careful that it does not get into the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with clean water.
  • After applying it to the oral mucosa or the gums, rinse the mouth thoroughly.

Possible side effects

  • If local irritation, an allergic reaction, or damage to the enamel of the teeth occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Interactions

  • Do not use it together with other preparations for external use.

This leaflet supports in-store consultation. Ask a pharmacist at the store about product choice and use. Products with the same ingredient, strength and form are managed to the same quality standard. Check by ingredient and strength rather than by product name.
